items.headline: Traders still keep shadow position sheets
items.summary: A CTRM Center analysis found that desks keep parallel spreadsheets not because ETRM calculation engines are weak, but because data pipelines are fragile and errors can go unnoticed until exposure is already real, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: UK EMIR reconciliation rules tightened
items.summary: The Bank of England and FCA updated UK EMIR validation rules, setting a new reconciliation start date of 28 September 2026 for previously deferred fields and removing the underlying-index name reconciliation requirement, per Regnology.

items.headline: Golden Week, canal limits squeeze ocean capacity
items.summary: October ocean freight conditions vary sharply by lane as Golden Week capacity cuts from China, Suez Canal changes and Panama Canal restrictions constrain usable vessel capacity, according to C.H. Robinson's October freight update.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn loan
items.summary: Trading house Trafigura completed an upsized US$4.4 billion syndicated loan facility, underscoring continued bank appetite for financing large commodity traders despite earlier sector stress, per GTR.
